messages:
alex: Pushing a config-only change to routing + batching for a canary run. Targeting canary-1 at 10%. Main tweaks: per-route max_inflight, default timeout, routing override for low-latency tier, batching.window_ms tightened. Will monitor p50/p95, errors, and cost per token.

deploy-bot: config_deploy initiated: v2026.04.12-rc3 -> clusters=[canary-1], percent=10, id=cfg-5f9c. Applying the following snippet:
```json
{
  \"routing\": { \"override_policy\": \"prefer-local\", \"max_inflight\": 120 },
  \"batching\": { \"window_ms\": 5, \"max_batch_tokens\": 4096 },
  \"timeout_ms\": 12000,
  \"kv_cache_ttl_s\": 600
}
```

priya: Quick Q: did we pin the model variant for the low-latency route so fallback won't accidentally hit a heavy variant?

alex: Yes — pinned route "ll-tier" -> model:v2.3-quant. Fallback chain: v2.2 (non-quant) then v1.9. No experimental models in this rollout.

jamie: I'll kick off a lightweight smoke suite against the canary. Please watch p95 and error-rate. Starting at 5rps ramp to 200rps over 10m.

observability-bot: smoke-run link: https://dash.redwood/workspace/rollouts/cfg-5f9c/smoke-1 - initial metrics: p50=52ms, p95=128ms, errors=0.14% (3/2100), avg_tokens=42.

rob: If p95 > 150ms OR errors > 0.5% during ramp -> automatic rollback. Also prefer human confirmation if we see cost regressions > 5%.

alex: Agreed. Rollback command is `deploy-bot rollback cfg-5f9c --immediate` and then pin previous routing. I'll be online for 30m.

deploy-bot: canary reached 10% across canary-1. No automatic rollback triggered.

priya: Note: batching.window_ms=5ms reduces idle latency but may change CPU tail. Keep an eye on p50 shifts.

jamie: Running the 200rps load test now, will post metrics every 2m.

observability-bot: ramp @ +200rps: p50=45ms, p95=120ms, errors=0.12%, tail_cpu=68%, token_cost_change=-3.1%. No abnormal error spikes.

alex: Looks good. Rolling to 50% across canary rings now.

deploy-bot: rollout update: target_percent=50 -> clusters=[canary-1, canary-2]. Progressing.

rob: After we hit 50% and hold for 15m without regressions, we follow the release playbook to 100% or schedule quiet-window for full rollout. Also add a release-note blurb.

priya: Draft release-note snippet: "Config-only: routing override to prefer-local for ll-tier, per-route max_inflight=120, batching.window_ms=5, timeout_ms=12000, kv_cache_ttl=600s. Pinned ll-tier to model:v2.3-quant."

alex: Perfect. I'll add that to the changelog and mark the deploy as monitored. If anything spikes, ping #oncall and I'll hit rollback. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout progress: 50% reached. Monitoring for 15m hold window.

observability-bot: hold snapshot @+5m: p50=47ms, p95=118ms, errors=0.11%. Holding steady.

rob: OK to proceed to ramp or schedule full rollout after hold. If anyone sees a late spike call it out.

alex: Proceeding to ramp later today to full outside quiet window. For now leaving canary at 50% and closing this thread for config monitoring. Thanks all.
